acceptance_criteria.statement: Authorized GitHub/Jira and a real worker/provider complete governed read/write/readback behavior, and the Windows service plus Command Center pass install, restart, recovery, interaction, and truthful-state checks.

definition_of_done: Exact remote readbacks bind GitHub/Jira outcomes.
At least one real qualified worker/provider dispatch passes.
Windows service and Command Center restart/recovery/truth pass.
description: Qualify the first authorized live governance and worker paths, then the native Windows supervisor and Command Center runtime.
exclusions: Mocks and source assets cannot satisfy live or Windows runtime qualification.
objective: Qualify live governance, real workers, Command Center, and Windows runtime
observability_impact: Captures exact remote readback, worker receipts, Windows health, restart, and UI projections.
rationale: The terminal product cannot be qualified solely in local mocks or offline preview.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Use sandbox targets, reversible service procedures, leases, and exact readback before retry.
security_impact: Requires independent approval, least privilege, scoped secret references, and redacted evidence.
title: Qualify live governance, real workers, Command Center, and Windows runtime
